free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS 3 finding in the right mid-gland peripheral zone directly triggered the cohort criterion, which the panel protocol confirmed as the ruling factor. This is supported by the finding of a PI-RADS 3 lesion and the csPCa predicted probability of 0.503. The evidence converged on biopsy, as the retrieved radiology report provided the necessary structural information to confirm the need for further investigation.
